name: Keeping Secrets
overview: Scripture emphasizes the wisdom and faithfulness required in keeping secrets, highlighting that a prudent and faithful person conceals knowledge rather than revealing it to others. The Proverbs warn against talebearers who disclose secrets and cause strife, urging believers to guard their speech to preserve their soul from trouble. Additionally, the counsel to resolve disputes privately and not expose confidences reflects the value of discretion. While secrecy can be virtuous, the Bible also teaches that covering sin leads to ruin, whereas confession and repentance bring mercy.
